context: Two managers debrief after a procurement meeting
purpose: Teach: 引き下げ/免除/落札/需給/補完/著名/完結/出入り

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お疲れ様です。先ほどの調達会議、結局あの著名なメーカーが最低価格で落札しましたね。
lines.en: Good work today. In the end, that famous manufacturer won the bid at the lowest price.
lines.style: Polite female office worker debriefing colleague after meeting

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、想定より大幅な引き下げで驚きました。需給のバランスが崩れている今、思い切った価格を出してきましたね。
lines.en: Yes, the reduction was bigger than expected. With supply and demand out of balance, they came in aggressively.
lines.style: Polite male office worker analyzing pricing decision in business tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 二社で相互に補完する形の提案も悪くなかったんですが、コスト面で押し切られた感じですね。
lines.en: The proposal where two firms complemented each other wasn't bad either, but they got beaten on cost.
lines.style: Reflective female colleague reviewing rejected alternative proposal

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうですね。あと、関税の免除が適用されるという点も向こうには有利に働いたと思います。
lines.en: Right. I think the tariff exemption being applicable also worked in their favor.
lines.style: Calm male manager pointing out regulatory advantage factor

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 確かに。会議室の出入りが激しかったのも、その辺の確認で各社バタバタしていたからでしょうね。
lines.en: True. The constant coming and going from the meeting room was probably each company scrambling to confirm that.
lines.style: Observant female remarking on chaotic meeting room atmosphere

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: では、この案件はひとまず完結ということで、報告書は私が今夜中にまとめておきます。
lines.en: Alright, let's consider this matter wrapped up for now. I'll put the report together by tonight.
lines.style: Decisive male colleague taking responsibility for next steps

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かります。明日の朝、部長に上げる前にもう一度二人で確認しましょう。
lines.en: That helps a lot. Let's review it together once more tomorrow morning before submitting to the director.
lines.style: Cooperative female suggesting final review before submission
